story.title: The Star Room

panels.desc: The top room of the tallest tower, dark inside. Outside the round windows a storm rages with a dark storm cloud and a yellow lightning flash. An unlit wooden torch sits in a bracket on the wall. In the dim room are shapes: a toy car, a little toy farm with a red barn, a golden horn and a big covered shape. Bun holds Pip close; Hedgie's spikes stand up; Pip reads in pieces; Fairy E glows faintly. Hidden in the picture: the storm, the torch, the toy car, the horn. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere.
panels.ko: 가장 높은 탑 꼭대기 방. 밖은 폭풍이 몰아쳐 깜깜해요. 벽에 꺼진 횃불이 있어요. 핍은 "토어… 치? 토치?"

panels.desc: Fairy E touches two little sparkles together with her star wand and they melt into one big bright sparkle at the tip of the torch. As the friends read the word, the torch bursts into a warm orange flame and lights the whole room. Now they can see: a big golden harp stands in the middle, and on a shelf a glass jar holds one tiny twinkling yellow star. Bun points at the harp and the jar; Beads stands on the toy car clicking its beads; Hedgie gasps. Hidden in the picture: the torch, the harp, the jar, the star, the toy car. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere.

lines.text: Look! A harp and a jar!

panels.ko: "torch!" 하자 횃불이 확 켜져요. 방 한가운데 금빛 하프, 선반 위 유리병 속에 작은 별이 반짝여요.

panels.desc: Hedgie opens the glass jar and the tiny star flies out and touches the strings of the golden harp. The harp plays by itself, and a single big glowing golden music note rises out of the strings and floats into Pip. Pip stands on top of the harp singing with its beak wide open, little golden notes streaming out. Bun and Hedgie clap; a golden horn, a corn cob and a silver fork on the shelf glow. Hidden in the picture: the harp, the star, the horn, the corn, the fork. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere.

lines.ko: 핍이 더 많이 노래할 수 있어요!

panels.ko: 별이 하프 줄에 닿자 하프가 저절로 울려요. 금빛 음표(노래 조각 넷)가 나와 핍에게 쏙! 핍이 노래해요.

ask.en: What comes out of the harp?

panels.desc: The storm has passed. Through the big round window of the top room, a clear golden sunset shows the whole land far below: green farms, the forest, the pond, the garden, and far, far away in the middle, a giant tree, the Song Tree, glowing softly. Grumble has climbed up to the top room with his drum and stands with the friends at the window, beating the drum once and grinning for the first time. Fairy E sits on Pip's head; Bun points far away; Hedgie shades his eyes. Hidden in the picture: the farm far below, a star twinkling in the sky, the toy car on the windowsill, a corn field. No letters anywhere.
panels.ko: 폭풍이 그치고 창밖으로 온 세상이 보여요. 저 멀리 한가운데 노래 나무가 빛나요. 그럼블이 처음으로 북을 "쿵!" 치며 활짝 웃어요.

ask.en: What can they see far away?

story.synopsis_ko: 가장 높은 탑 꼭대기 방. 밖은 폭풍이라 깜깜해요. 핍은 "토어… 치?" 요정 이가 반짝이 둘을 하나로 합치고 "torch!" 하자 횃불이 켜져요. 하프와 별이 든 병이 보여요. 별이 하프 줄에 닿자 금빛 음표(노래 조각 넷)가 나와 핍에게 들어가요. 폭풍이 그치고 창밖 멀리 노래 나무가 보여요. 그럼블이 처음으로 북을 "쿵!" 쳐요.
story.so_far_ko: 구름을 걷어 달이 나왔어요. 그럼블이 옥상 소파에서 함께 달을 봤어요.
story.goal_ko: 모음 뒤에 r 이 오는 ar·or 단어를 읽고 꼭대기 방에서 노래 조각 넷을 찾아요.
